intent: Inspect and refactor RecordTelemetryService without changing its ast_hints API: verify layering (domain types only in ports, no blocking calls, no hardcoded config values), reactive lifecycle/backpressure, and that tests stay green. Unit: Context Telemetry Event Ledger. @Service. Constructor(TelemetryLedgerRepository, Clock). Never re-validates or reorders. record: Validated/ValidationFailed event -> if no revision exists append ORIGINAL (revision 1, failed payload retained); if one exists and value or status differs append CORRECTION, otherwise return the latest unchanged (idempotent replay). BackfillReordered -> append BACKFILL as latest.next(...) (ORIGINAL if none exists). WindowBuffered and RevisionAppended -> Mono.empty(). Existing revisions are never modified.
